name: KY-001 temperature sensor (DS18B20)
not_buildable: The temperature sensor sends its readings over a one-wire data protocol. It needs an extra Arduino library, and LearnLens only compiles sketches with its two approved libraries.
identification: Small black PCB with 3 angled header pins at one end and a black half-round three-legged chip (like a small transistor) standing upright. Looks much like the KY-003 and KY-035, whose chips are flat and lie beyond the board edge.

facts.statement: The DS18B20 reports temperature digitally over a 1-Wire bus. The vendor's example uses the OneWire and DallasTemperature libraries.
facts.source: Joy-IT SensorKit, KY-001, technical data and code example
